server: vLLM 0.10.2, MemexKVConnector, native prefix cache + external cold KV

1_hybrid_native_first.policy: native prefix cache serves locally-computed prefix; external connector only when num_computed_tokens==0 and prefix >= min_prefix_tokens
1_hybrid_native_first.evidence: unique 2,933-token prefix: cold first request external hit 0.363s; second native 0.024s; short prefixes 512/1024/1856 stay native 0.013-0.020s

2_batch_parallel_load.detail: per-request layer KV files loaded in parallel with ThreadPoolExecutor(8) before injection
2_batch_parallel_load.evidence: cold external fallback completed; no isolated sequential-vs-parallel benchmark

5_cold_only_compression.policy: external KV is the cold tier; gzip optional for external storage only, native hot path never compressed
5_cold_only_compression.evidence: 7B compressed external KV 222MiB vs 652MiB but hit latency ~0.43s; use only for cold storage

6_group_external_loads.detail: loads grouped per request and parallelized across layers; manifest validates prefix before load
6_group_external_loads.evidence: enabled in successful cold fallback; dedicated throughput comparison pending

caveats: Single GPU/process; some figures from repetitive-prefix probes.
Batch-load optimization has no isolated A/B benchmark yet.
